_comment: Copy to config/games.json and edit. 'sources' entries are parsed by sources/web.py; the canned source ignores urls and reads data/snapshots/ instead.

confidence._comment: Tunables for agent/model.py. See ABOUT.md for what these mean.
confidence._purge_comment: Deliberately stricter than dead_threshold so a code stays visible in grey for a while before PURGE retires it. See model.should_purge().
confidence._kind_comment: ABOUT.md: 'codes tied to a limited-time event decay faster than milestone codes'. These multiply half_life_days per code kind, so the 'how the world evolves' component is not uniform across codes.

source_trust._comment: Starting trust per source, 0.0 to 1.0. Updated at runtime when refinement is enabled.
source_trust._refinement_comment: How hard a user-reported outcome moves a listing source's trust. Only applied when the GUI refinement toggle is on (see ABOUT.md, 'the correction step').

slayers2._note: Fill roblox_url with the game's page if you want the GUI to link to it.
